summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, closed its initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the 3,000,000-unit over-allotment option, raising $230 million in gross proceeds. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-half of a redeemable warrant, each whole warrant exercisable at $11.50. The company entered an underwriting agreement with Santander US Capital Markets, a warrant agreement, an investment management trust agreement, a registration rights agreement and a private placement warrants purchase agreement. Post-IPO the trust holds public proceeds pending a business combination; watch deal-sourcing pace, extension/redemption risk and warrant overhang.
